list.en: Now the turkey should be crispy on the outside, and juicy on the inside.
list.cn: 火鸡现在应该外皮焦脆、里面鲜嫩多汁了。

list.en: That's amazing! I always kept the turkey wrapped in foil the entire time it was in the oven. I guess that's why the outside was never crispy.
list.cn: 我一直用锡纸把火鸡包着放在烤炉里。我想那是外皮从来不脆的原因。
